create_job_config: create a JobConfig dataclass to configure a fairchem training job with run name, device type, and scheduler settings
configure_slurm_job: configure a SlurmConfig dataclass to set memory, timeout, CPUs per task, and partition for SLURM job submission
configure_scheduler: configure a SchedulerConfig dataclass to set scheduler mode, ranks per node, and SLURM or Ray cluster options
set_device_type: set a DeviceType enum to CPU or CUDA to specify the compute device for a fairchem job
set_scheduler_type: set a SchedulerType enum to LOCAL or SLURM to choose the job scheduling backend
